/// Three Pillars VoIP — iOS XCFramework
///
/// This directory contains the iOS XCFramework build scaffolding for the
/// Three Pillars VoIP library. The XCFramework wraps the Rust native library
/// built from `crates/voip-ffi` with Swift bindings generated by UniFFI.
///
/// # Build Instructions
///
/// 1. Add Rust iOS targets:
///    ```sh
///    rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios x86_64-apple-ios aarch64-apple-ios-sim
///    cargo install cargo-lipo
///    ```
///
/// 2. Build the universal static library:
///    ```sh
///    cd /path/to/three-pillars-voip
///    cargo lipo --release -p voip-ffi
///    ```
///    This produces `target/universal/release/libvoip_ffi.a`
///
/// 3. Generate Swift bindings:
///    ```sh
///    cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen generate \
///      --library target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libvoip_ffi.a \
///      --language swift \
///      --out-dir mobile/ios/Sources
///    ```
///
/// 4. Create XCFramework:
///    ```sh
///    xcodebuild -create-xcframework \
///      -library target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libvoip_ffi.a \
///      -headers mobile/ios/Sources \
///      -library target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/release/libvoip_ffi.a \
///      -headers mobile/ios/Sources \
///      -output mobile/ios/ThreePillarsVoIP.xcframework
///    ```
///
/// # Usage in iOS App
///
/// 1. Drag `ThreePillarsVoIP.xcframework` into your Xcode project
/// 2. Add the generated Swift files to your project
/// 3. Initialize:
/// ```swift
/// let config = VoipConfig(
///     discovery_privacy_first: true,
///     dht_lookup_timeout_ms: 200,
///     dht_bootstrap_nodes: ["/ip4/.../p2p/Qm..."],
///     signaling_server_url: "wss://signal.example.com/v1/ws",
///     masque_fallback_enabled: true,
///     push_retry_enabled: true,
///     quic_connect_timeout_ms: 5000,
///     call_ring_timeout_ms: 30000
/// )
/// let client = VoipClient(config: config)
/// try client.init()
/// try client.call(peerId: "peer-abc123")
/// ```
///
/// # Important Notes
///
/// - DHT is **lookup-only** on mobile — no full routing/storage APIs exposed
/// - The library uses a shared tokio runtime internally
/// - All async operations are bridged via `block_on()` on a background thread
/// - Call operations must not be invoked from the main thread
